STATUS: ANSWER
Use the -R (--regions-file) option with a tab-delimited file. The file can list positions as two columns (CHROM, POS) or intervals as three columns (CHROM, BEG, END), but not both in the same file. Positions are 1-based and inclusive [bcftools_manual#h007]. If the file has a .bed or .bed.gz suffix, it is read as BED instead, with 0-based, half-open coordinates [bcftools_manual#h007]. The option requires indexed VCF/BCF files and cannot be combined with -r [bcftools_manual#h007].
